question.question: Can Alliance first Spread Sympathy into a clearing and then Revolt there in that same Birdsong?

expected.expected_answer: No. All Revolts precede Spread Sympathy; cannot return to Revolt step after spreading.

source_passages.quotation: **Birdsong:** Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. **For both actions, every supporter spent must match the target clearing; birds are wild.** Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt:

answer.part: Spread then Revolt in one Birdsong
answer.ruling: No. Complete all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy. Once spreading begins, you cannot return to Revolt that Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a Revolt in the same Birdsong.
